benchmarks.notes: Vulnerable to synonym variations (e.g. misses 'ML' when querying 'Machine Learning'). High false negative rate.
Captures conceptual semantics well, but cannot enforce mandatory hard constraints or verify experience tenure.
Trained on held-out 80/20 train/test split. Calibrated decision boundaries; limited by vocabulary overlap.

benchmarks.model_name: TalentLens AI Hybrid Engine (Deterministic + Dense + Multi-Criteria)
benchmarks.notes: Best overall performance. Combines deterministic mandatory skill coverage, dense semantic embeddings, and tenure alignment with 100% evidence attribution.

calibration_summary: Match scores are normalized linear combinations of multi-attribute utility features; cohort relative percentiles are calibrated against the active applicant pool.

proxy_bias_audit.feature_audit_notes: Scoring inputs are restricted strictly to canonical skills, verified work duration, and project portfolio artifacts. No proxy metrics (such as graduation decade or institution ranking tiers) are incorporated.
